name: kexec_load
synopsis: long syscall(SYS_kexec_load, unsigned long entry, unsigned long nr_segments, struct kexec_segment *segments, unsigned long flags);
long syscall(SYS_kexec_file_load, int kernel_fd, int initrd_fd, unsigned long cmdline_len, const char *cmdline, unsigned long flags);
description: The kexec_load() system call loads a new kernel for later execution using reboot(2). It specifies kernel layout and flags for control. Additionally, kexec_file_load() loads a kernel from file descriptors with a command line.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Physical entry address in the kernel image

parameters.name: nr_segments
parameters.description: Number of segments in the segments array (up to 16)

parameters.name: segments
parameters.description: Array of kexec_segment structures defining the kernel layout

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bit mask for controlling the operation, including KEXEC_ON_CRASH and architecture constants

parameters.name: kernel_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the kernel file

parameters.name: initrd_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor for the initrd file

parameters.name: cmdline_len
parameters.description: Length of the command line string

parameters.name: cmdline
parameters.description: The command line string for the kernel

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: The KEXEC_ON_CRASH flag was specified, but a segment region lies outside reserved crash kernel memory
A mem or memsz field in segments is not a multiple of the system page size
kernel_fd or initrd_fd is not a valid file descriptor
Another crash kernel is already being loaded or in use
A bufsz field in segments exceeds the corresponding memsz
Two or more kernel target buffers overlap
The cmdline string does not end with '\0'
The file referred to by kernel_fd or initrd_fd is empty
kernel_fd does not refer to a loadable file
The caller does not have the CAP_SYS_BOOT capability

versions: Linux 2.6.13 for kexec_load, Linux 3.17 for kexec_file_load
